name: yaoharee-lahtee-seth
description: SETH (Social-Enterprise Technical Handler) — an AI skill that executes MOCA, the Mission Opportunity–Constraint Architecture: a readout-bounded, falsifiable calculation framework for social-enterprise management. Developed by Yaoharee Lahtee.

plugins.name: seth
plugins.description: Load before analyzing, diagnosing, or simulating any social enterprise or hybrid mission-driven organization: viability, mission drift, mission-attributable cost/opportunity (the four benchmarks and O_M − C_M identity), trust/liquidity/obligation dynamics, impact-claim support audits, and prediction-freeze falsification. Enforces the MOCA AI calculation contract: every quantity typed with equation id, identification status, tier, and support bundles; missing is NI, never zero; model counterfactuals are never relabeled as observed facts.
